title: underwater-semcom-benchmark: reference evaluation protocol for underwater semantic communications
description: Reference implementation of the evaluation protocol of the survey 'Enabling Intelligence in the Deep: A Comprehensive Survey of Semantic Communications for Underwater Wireless Systems' (Proceedings of the IEEE, submitted): reference acoustic and optical channels (including replay of the measured Watermark channels), frozen and deduplicated dataset splits, fidelity/rate/complexity metrics, a separate source-channel coding baseline (JPEG 2000 + 5G NR LDPC) with its ideal separation bound, and a common result format. No third-party data is redistributed.
